title: CDC Art. 42 Violation — Consumer Exposed to Ridicule, Constraint, and Threats by LATAM Staff at GRU Airport
incident_timestamp_display: April 4, 2024, 02:05 AM BRT — Guarulhos International Airport (GRU), São Paulo, Brazil
allegation_summary: On 4 April 2024, at Guarulhos Airport, LATAM counter staff member André BD Marinho subjected passenger Leandro Disconzi to a sustained campaign of severe verbal abuse, ridicule, threats, and public humiliation. Marinho repeatedly used extreme profanity: 'Ah, vai tomar no cu, velho' (Index 40), self‑identified while cursing 'André BD Marinho está mandando esse imbecil tomar no cu' (Index 44), and later escalated to 'eu mando no seu cuzão do caralho' (Index 75). He issued veiled threats: 'Você acha que tem um louco pra cima de mim?' (Index 38). The abuse occurred at ~2:00 AM while the passenger was stranded after a missed connection. Marinho continued the harassment even after acknowledging that he was being recorded. This conduct violates the consumer's dignity and the CDC's prohibition on exposing consumers to ridicule, constraint, or threats (Art. 42), exploits the consumer's vulnerability (Art. 39, IV), and offends the fundamental principles of the National Consumer Policy (Art. 4, caput and I). This incident occurred solely at GRU; no lifetime ban was imposed.

articles.article_name: CDC, Art. 42 – Proibição de expor o consumidor a ridículo, constrangimento ou ameaça
articles.article_text: Art. 42° Na cobrança de débitos, o consumidor inadimplente não será exposto a ridículo, nem será submetido a qualquer tipo de constrangimento ou ameaça.
articles.applicability_rationale: Demoted from 'direct_by_analogy' to 'supporting'. CDC Art. 42 is textually about debt collection (cobrança de débitos). Its applicability to general consumer interactions is by jurisprudential extension of the dignity principle. CDC Art. 4, caput and Art. 4, I are now the primary statutory anchors for consumer dignity in service contexts. Art. 42 retained as doctrinal/jurisprudential support for the broader principle that consumers shall not be exposed to ridicule, constraint, or threats in any commercial interaction. | legacy paraphrase: Art. 42. Na cobranca de debitos, o consumidor inadimplente nao sera exposto a ridiculo, nem sera submetido a qualquer tipo de constrangimento ou ameaca. Paragrafo unico. O consumidor cobrado em quantia indevida tem direito a repeticao do indebito, por valor igual ao dobro do que pagou em excesso, acrescido de correcao monetaria e juros legais, salvo hipotese de engano justificavel
